part.text:
Fixed. In `src/diff/index.js:346`, when a component throws during render and the error is caught by a boundary, the diff catch block only preserved the old DOM for hydrating/initial-mount bailouts. For update-time errors (the list-item case), the errored vnode ended up with no `_dom`/`_children`, so when the boundary re-rendered with a different return type, the item was rendered twice — once errored, once normal.

The fix adds an `else` branch that carries over `oldVNode._dom` and `oldVNode._children` to the errored `newVNode` before `_catchError` runs (matching upstream preactjs/preact#4182).

- `hooks/test/browser/errorBoundary.test.js`: all 6 pass, including the previously failing "should not duplicate in lists..." case.
- Full browser suite: 1075 passed / 30 failed vs baseline 1074 / 31 — identical pre-existing failure set, one extra pass, no regressions.
- `test/shared` + `test/node` mocha: 29 passing.
